title: Diagnose cron environment and access faults
goal: Repair lookup and executable access under cron environment.
challenge: Use the supplied faulty fixture. Diagnose lookup and access, repair narrowly and prove actual cron success. Do not broaden world permissions or test only as root.

steps.command: ! getent passwd ll-s4 && ! getent group ll-s4 && test ! -e /home/ll-s4 && sudo useradd -m -U -s /bin/bash ll-s4

printf '%s\n' '#!/bin/bash' PATH=/usr/bin:/bin 'umask 077' 'cd /home/ll-s4 || exit 3' 'report-helper > report.txt' | sudo tee /home/ll-s4/job.sh > /dev/null && sudo chown ll-s4:ll-s4 /home/ll-s4/job.sh && sudo chmod 0700 /home/ll-s4/job.sh

sudo runuser -u ll-s4 -- mkdir /home/ll-s4/bin; printf '%s\n' '#!/bin/bash' 'printf "user=%s\n" "$(id -un)"' | sudo tee /home/ll-s4/bin/report-helper > /dev/null && sudo chown ll-s4:ll-s4 /home/ll-s4/bin/report-helper && sudo chmod 0600 /home/ll-s4/bin/report-helper

sudo test ! -e /var/spool/cron/crontabs/ll-s4 && printf '%s\n' 'MAILTO=""' 'SHELL=/bin/sh' 'PATH=/usr/bin:/bin' '* * * * * umask 077; /usr/bin/timeout -k 1s 5s /home/ll-s4/job.sh > /home/ll-s4/stdout.txt 2> /home/ll-s4/error.txt; echo $? > /home/ll-s4/status.txt' | sudo crontab -u ll-s4 -; end=$((SECONDS+85)); until sudo test -s /home/ll-s4/error.txt; do test "$SECONDS" -lt "$end" || break; sleep 1; done; sudo cat /home/ll-s4/error.txt
steps.expected: Command not found,127; empty report is not success.

steps.command: sudo sed -i.bak 's#^report-helper#/home/ll-s4/bin/report-helper#' /home/ll-s4/job.sh; sudo runuser -u ll-s4 -- env -i HOME=/home/ll-s4 PATH=/usr/bin:/bin /bin/bash /home/ll-s4/job.sh; printf 'status=%s\n' "$?"
steps.explanation: Repair lookup then test minimal environment.
steps.expected: Permission denied,126; absolute path does not fix mode.

steps.command: sudo chmod 0700 /home/ll-s4/bin/report-helper; end=$((SECONDS+85)); until sudo test -s /home/ll-s4/report.txt; do test "$SECONDS" -lt "$end" || break; sleep 1; done; sudo runuser -u ll-s4 -- cat /home/ll-s4/report.txt; sudo stat -c "%U:%G %a %s" /home/ll-s4/report.txt
steps.explanation: Repair only owner execute; wait for actual cron.
steps.expected: Valid ll-s4 line, error overwritten empty.

hints: Path and permission faults are separate.
review: Cron error, minimal-env127/126, final real cron report/empty error.
coverage: LPIC-1 v5.0 107.2 partial cron/systemd timers; 105.2/108.2 reinforcement; self-reviewed, unscored. No at or full objective coverage.
